title: Ordinary coefficient maps in normalized affine pushforward coordinates
statement: Let R,A,B,D be commutative rings, with R-algebra structures on A and B and an (A tensor_R B)-algebra structure on D. Assume derived categories of R-modules, B-modules, and sheaves of modules on every scheme exist. Let M be an arbitrary unbounded complex of A-modules and m a BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B M D [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Let phi:A→D and psi:B→D be the restrictions of the algebra map A tensor_R B→D along the left and right tensor inclusions, with fixed witnesses hphi:alpha composed with the left tensor inclusion equals phi and hpsi:alpha composed with the right tensor inclusion equals psi. Let alpha be the tensor-algebra map, j the right tensor inclusion, C extension of M along alpha restricted to A, and Cg extension along phi. Put cE=m.comparison(i) followed by H^i(m.ordinaryToLocalized) and the forward exact alpha-restriction homology comparison, rho the scalar-restriction composition isomorphism, s=res_j(cE) followed by rho.inv on H^i(C), and z0 the homology of equality transport C=Cg. Let V be the termwise psi-restriction of Cg. The tilde of res_j(m.comparison i) followed by res_j(H^i(m.ordinaryToLocalized) followed by the forward exact alpha-restriction comparison), rho.inv, res_psi(z0), and the inverse psi-restriction homology comparison, followed by the inverse exact tilde homology comparison on V, inverse Q/homology comparison, homology of the termwise affine pushforward comparison, and homology of the right-derived unit, equals tilde(s) followed by tilde(res_psi(z0)) followed by affineTildePushforwardCohomologyMap. This is a statement only about ordinary coefficient homology maps and pushforward normalization; it does not use m.counit, m.derived, or m.cohomologyIso.

theorem affineTildeCoefficientPushforwardHomologyCoordinates
    (R A B D : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing D]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] B) D]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wM} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wM} (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (m : ModuleCat.BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B M D)
    (φ : A →+* D) (ψ : B →+* D)
    (hφ : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)) = φ)
    (hψ : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = ψ) (i : ℤ) :
    let α := algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D
    let j : B →+* A ⊗[R] B := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom
    let T := affineTildeFunctor B
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of B)).toRingedSpace)) i
    let C := (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (α.comp
      (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)
    let Cg := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M
    let ρ := ModuleCat.restrictScalarsComp' j α ψ hψ.symm
    let z₀ := (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} D) (.up ℤ) i).map
      (eqToHom (by dsimp only [C, α]; rw [hφ] : C = Cg))
    let V := ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ψ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Cg
    let _ : (affineTildeFunctor B).Additive :=
      instAdditiveModuleCatCarrierModulesSpecOfFunctor
    let _ : (affineTildeFunctor B).PreservesHomology := tilde_preservesHomology B
    let _ : (affineTildeFunctor D).Additive :=
      instAdditiveModuleCatCarrierModulesSpecOfFunctor
    let P := Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ))
    let _ : P.Additive := inferInstance
    let _ : (affineTildeFunctor D ⋙ P).PreservesZeroMorphisms :=
      ⟨fun _ _ ↦ by
        rw [Functor.comp_map, (affineTildeFunctor D).map_zero]
        exact P.map_zero _ _⟩
    let a := ((affineTildePushforwardComparison D B ψ).hom.mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).app Cg
    let β := (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ)).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((affineTildeFunctor D).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Cg))
    T.map ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars j).map (m.comparison i) ≫
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars j).map
          (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap m.ordinaryToLocalized i ≫
            ((C.sc i).mapHomologyIso (ModuleCat.restrictScalars α)).hom) ≫
        ρ.inv.app (C.homology i) ≫ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars ψ).map z₀ ≫
        ((Cg.sc i).mapHomologyIso (ModuleCat.restrictScalars ψ)).inv) ≫
      ((V.sc i).mapHomologyIso (affineTildeFunctor B)).inv ≫
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactors _ i).inv.app
        (((affineTildeFunctor B).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj V) ≫
      H.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map a) ≫ H.map β =
      T.map ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars j).map (m.comparison i)) ≫
      T.map ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars j).map
        (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap m.ordinaryToLocalized i)) ≫
      T.map ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars j).map
        ((C.sc i).mapHomologyIso (ModuleCat.restrictScalars α)).hom) ≫
      T.map (ρ.inv.app (C.homology i)) ≫
      T.map ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ψ).map z₀) ≫
        affineTildePushforwardCohomologyMap D B ψ Cg i
